sentences.english: It is Saturday morning.

sentences.text: Sam y Ana van al centro del pueblo.
sentences.english: Sam and Ana go to the center of the village.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Ana, what can we give Nico as a gift?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: His birthday is in September.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Mi cumpleaños es en abril, y el de Luis es en junio.
sentences.english: My birthday is in April, and Luis's is in June.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: And you, Sam?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I was born in July.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Well, Nico needs some shoes.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Los usa cada día, y ya están muy viejos.
sentences.english: He wears them every day, and they are already very old.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And a shirt?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Nico does not wear one.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Quiere una camiseta azul con un perro.
sentences.english: He wants a blue T-shirt with a dog.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: He is always talking about dogs.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Who sells them here?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Doña Elena.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Tiene un negocio pequeño cerca de la iglesia.
sentences.english: She has a small business near the church.

sentences.text: La tienda de doña Elena tiene paredes blancas, un techo alto, mucha luz y un piso limpio.
sentences.english: Doña Elena's store has white walls, a high roof, a lot of light and a clean floor.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Good morning.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: What are you looking for?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Good morning, ma'am.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Buscamos unos zapatos y una camiseta para un niño.
sentences.english: We are looking for some shoes and a T-shirt for a boy.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Who are they for?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: They are for Nico.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Tiene diez años, pero en septiembre va a tener once.
sentences.english: He is ten, but in September he will be eleven.

sentences.text: Doña Elena mostró unos zapatos negros y los puso en la mesa.
sentences.english: Doña Elena showed some black shoes and put them on the table.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Which one is better?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: The black ones.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Nico juega mucho, y los blancos no quedan limpios.
sentences.english: Nico plays a lot, and white ones do not stay clean.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Nico is not here.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: We cannot try them on.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Don't worry.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Si no quedan bien, usted puede cambiarlos.
sentences.english: If they do not fit, you can exchange them.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How much do they cost?

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: They cost three hundred lempiras.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: I have some with animals.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Unas tienen caballos, otras tienen gallinas.
sentences.english: Some have horses, others have hens.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Cuestan ciento veinte lempiras cada una.
sentences.english: They cost one hundred twenty lempiras each.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Do you have one with a dog?

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: I think so.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: I do not see it here.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: It is in that box.

sentences.text: Doña Elena la abre y busca.
sentences.english: Doña Elena opens it and looks.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Here it is.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Es azul, y el perro es blanco y negro.
sentences.english: It is blue, and the dog is black and white.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: It is very pretty!

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I want it.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Is it for a gift?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Yes.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Es un regalo para un niño.
sentences.english: It is a gift for a boy.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sam, mirá aquel vestido con unas flores.
sentences.english: Sam, look at that dress with some flowers.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: I have two blue ones.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Which one do you want to try on?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: That one, the one with the flowers.

sentences.text: Doña Elena mostró el cuarto pequeño, y Ana fue allí.
sentences.english: Doña Elena showed the small room, and Ana went there.
Sam waits.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: How do I look?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: You look very good.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: It fits you very well.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: How much does that dress cost?

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: It costs one hundred fifty lempiras.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: It is expensive.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Pero cada domingo voy al culto, y quiero un vestido nuevo.
sentences.english: But every Sunday I go to the service, and I want a new dress.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I am saving for a trip.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: I am going to think about it.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: You can come in November.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Entonces va a estar más barato.
sentences.english: Then it will be cheaper.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Doña Elena, ¿hace mucho que tiene este negocio?
sentences.english: Doña Elena, have you had this business for a long time?

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Twenty years.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Aquel señor viejo es mi papá.
sentences.english: That old man is my dad.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Era carpintero y construyó esta tienda.
sentences.english: He was a carpenter and he built this store.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Mi abuelo tenía una finca, pero mi papá quería trabajar en el pueblo.
sentences.english: My grandfather had a farm, but my dad wanted to work in the village.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How has the village changed?

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: A lot.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: There were many changes.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Antes aquí había tierra y no había calle.
sentences.english: Before, there was dirt here and no street.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: El gobierno construyó la calle, y la comunidad ayudó.
sentences.english: The government built the street, and the community helped.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Today I want to improve the business.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: En este país, un negocio crece poco a poco.
sentences.english: In this country, a business grows little by little.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Your store is very nice.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Yo también necesito un pantalón negro y una camisa blanca para el culto.
sentences.english: I also need a pair of black pants and a white shirt for the service.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Do you have them?

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Yes, I have them.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: The shirt is here.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Ese pantalón es bueno, pero no sé si queda bien.
sentences.english: Those pants are good, but I do not know if they fit well.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Quiero ver si me queda bien.
sentences.english: I want to see if it fits me.
Sam tried on the pants.
They were too big.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Can you show me a smaller pair?

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Yes, one moment.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: This one fits well.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: It costs two hundred lempiras.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I want to pay for everything.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: What is the bill?

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: La cuenta es de seiscientos veinte lempiras.
sentences.english: The bill is six hundred twenty lempiras.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Sam, do you want to save?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Buy the gift first.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Lo otro lo podés comprar en octubre.
sentences.english: You can buy the rest in October.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: All right.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Hoy quiero el regalo para Nico.
sentences.english: Today I want the gift for Nico.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.text: Entonces paguen en la caja, por favor.
sentences.english: Then please pay at the register.

sentences.speaker: E
sentences.english: Who is going to pay?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I am.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And I like giving gifts.

sentences.text: Doña Elena puso el regalo en una caja grande.
sentences.english: Doña Elena put the gift in a big box.

sentences.text: Sam pagó, y los dos salieron contentos.
sentences.english: Sam paid, and the two left happy.

sentences.text: El cumpleaños de Nico fue en septiembre, en el patio de la casa donde vive.
sentences.english: Nico's birthday was in September, in the patio of the house where he lives.

sentences.text: Ana invitó a los vecinos y a la tía Carmen.
sentences.english: Ana invited the neighbors and aunt Carmen.

sentences.text: Había flores en el jardín y luces en el árbol.
sentences.english: There were flowers in the garden and lights in the tree.

sentences.text: La tía Carmen trajo un cuento para los niños: el cuento de una vaca y una gallina en una finca.
sentences.english: Aunt Carmen brought a story for the children: the story of a cow and a hen on a farm.
The children listened without speaking.
Nico opened the gift.

sentences.text: Lo miró y no dijo nada.
sentences.english: He looked at it and said nothing.

sentences.text: Después dijo: —Nunca tuve un regalo así.
sentences.english: Then he said, "I have never had a gift like this.
It is the best gift in the country!"

sentences.text: Se puso la camiseta del perro, y parecía muy contento.
sentences.english: He put on the T-shirt with the dog, and he looked very happy.

sentences.text: —Voy a usar mi regalo mañana en la escuela —dijo.
sentences.english: "I am going to wear my gift tomorrow at school," he said.

sentences.text: Los niños jugaron con una pelota, y Nico ganó.
sentences.english: The children played with a ball, and Nico won.

sentences.text: Por la noche, Nico miró la luna y las estrellas.
sentences.english: At night, Nico looked at the moon and the stars.

sentences.text: Ya no había oscuridad en el patio, porque había luces.
sentences.english: There was no darkness in the patio anymore, because there were lights.

sentences.text: —Nico va a recordar este día —dijo doña Marta.
sentences.english: "Nico is going to remember this day," said doña Marta.
